content.headline: Your vision,
content.subheadline: Integrated contracting for seamless project excellence worldwide, built on KAT Group experience.

content.label: 01 — Who we are
content.headline: Building the future
content.body:
KAT Arabia General Contracting, established in 2024, is a forward-looking contracting company delivering high-quality engineering, construction and infrastructure solutions to clients worldwide.

Our integrated approach combines technical excellence, operational efficiency and structured project management, so execution stays seamless from design and engineering through construction, commissioning and maintenance.

We are committed to delivering sustainable, high-quality projects on time and within budget.

content.label: 02 — How we deliver
content.headline: One partner across the whole project life.

steps.title: Design & engineering
steps.text: Buildability, value engineering and coordinated discipline design before the first peg goes in.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Civil, structural, mechanical and electrical works under one site organisation.

steps.title: Commissioning
steps.text: Testing, start-up and handover documentation, ready for the owner’s operations team.

steps.title: Maintenance
steps.text: Facility and building maintenance that keeps completed assets performing.

content.label: 03 — Part of KAT Group
content.headline: Group experience.
content.body: KAT Arabia brings KAT Group’s contracting and workforce capability to projects worldwide, with operations expanding from 2026 across a growing network of regional offices.

steps.title: Safety
steps.text: Zero-harm planning on every site, for every crew.

steps.title: Quality
steps.text: Work delivered to specification and inspected before handover.

steps.title: Time & budget
steps.text: Structured project controls that keep schedules and costs honest.

steps.title: Sustainability
steps.text: Responsible methods, materials and energy use across our work.

content.label: 02 — Workforce
content.headline: Crews we recruit, test
content.body: Skilled and semi-skilled workers sourced from twelve countries — India, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Philippines, Ghana, Kenya, Uganda, Sierra Leone, Cameroon, Burundi — and deployed into projects worldwide, for our own packages or as manpower supply to clients.
